sense: the document you show at a border

pins.definition: An official document issued by a government that identifies a citizen for international travel.
An official document with your photo and personal details that allows you to travel between countries.
An official document with a photograph used to prove who you are when traveling across borders.

situation: A traveler at a wooden immigration desk holds up an open booklet to an official.
subject: the passport
brief: A traveler holds an open blue passport flat against the counter, perfectly centered and brightly lit against the flat muted tones of the border station. The gold crest on its cover glows softly, catching the eye before anything else in the frame.
prompt: A traveler holds an open blue passport flat against the counter, perfectly centered and brightly lit against the flat muted tones of the border station. The gold crest on its cover glows softly, catching the eye before anything else in the frame. a mid-century travel poster painted in gouache, rich opaque colour, confident simplified forms with real painted texture, strong diagonal composition. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
